title: Additional Netherite Armors
description: Adds the warped, crimson and soul netherite tier.
body:
![ADNA](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6b6329917cfb96d9064d5808425c88e276494a4.png)
  SUPPORT FOR 26.1.2 OUT NOW!
 
  Additional Netherite Armors is the first part of the Additional Netherite series. This is a mod that adds three new variants of Nethrite Armor which each give the player a special ability when the full set is worn.

![armors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a2e186643d6c9fece1836d77815071833311d1a.png)
-Crimson Armor
  Gives permanant fire ressistance and a 3% chance that all damage will be negated if hurt and is better than normal Netherite Armor.

-Warped Armor
  Gives the Warped Weleport abillity which allows the player to teleport 7 blocks in any direction and is significantly worse than Netherite Armor but better than Diamond Armor.

-Soul Armor
  Gives a permanant increase in movement speed and the Soul-Steal abillity which grants a 2% chance that the player will be given a heart when attacking a player and is slightly worse than Netherite Armor but much better than Diamond Armor.

Recipes:
  To make any type of new netherite armor variant the player must first obtain the essence of that variant from the specific biome. For Crimson Essence the player must find a crimson fungus in the Crimson Forrest. Then, smelt it in a furnace (smelting will take 2.5 minutes).     
![CrimsonE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48a88a3336d1348b4b732192be7e2948aa5eb88d.png)

For the Warped Essence the player will need to smelt Warped Fungus and for Soul Essence the player will need to smelt a dried ghast.

Secondly the player must craft a Crimson, Warped or Soul Scrap which is made using 4 of the biome specific essence, 4 Nether Gold Ore, and 1 Netherite Scrap.
  
  ![CrimsonS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db85c97a988a67631b56d9fe1d9f9cd3404184aa.png)

Then, once the player has obtained the biome specific scrap, they can make either the Crimson, Warped, or Soul Ingots or Templates.

The ingot is crafted with 4 gold ingots and 4 of the selected scrap.
   
   ![CrimsonI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/599b2c482875344a53812cf06c7f8870dd2076e9.png)

A Upgrade Template of the player's choice is crafted with 1 Netherite Upgrade Template and 4 of the selected scrap.
 
  ![CrimsonT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7cb022604d0eb00630efb2361aabf4764bf09603.png)

After the chosen template is crafted a template duping recipe will be unlocked. The player would craft this using 1 of the added scraps, 1 template of the same kind of Netherite tier.
 
 ![CrimsonD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b2c42a38406f1d3ec9fd313fc251e2d1db26bd5.png)

Lastly, the armor is crafted in a smithing table using 1 of the Crimson, Warped, or Soul template, a piece of Netherite Armor.
 
 ![CrimsonA](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2bca35883f1688e5dcfdb16d55350ee7f6cbfec.png)


Follow For More. God Bless.
